description:
Marcus, who is not good at communicating with people and has a shy personality, unexpectedly becomes the head of the "Occult Incident Countermeasures Department" in a mix-up. Faced with a group of eccentric and unpredictable colleagues such as Regulus and Medicine Pocket, can Marcus, who is usually nervous even when speaking loudly, step up in times of crisis and become the backbone that unites this strange team? —Do they seem strange... are they really "unreliable" in reality?
source: bgm.tv\googletranslate
